description.zh-CN: 代码插件示例：注册两条带快捷键的命令（⇧⌘K 把选中图层移到画面中心，⇧⌘U 把缩放 / 旋转归位），并在主工具条放两个按钮。改动经 doc.editObject 提交，可以撤销。需要 doc 权限（高风险：能改文档）。
description.en: Code plugin example: registers two commands with shortcuts (⇧⌘K centers the selected layer, ⇧⌘U resets its scale / rotation) and adds two buttons to the main toolbar. Edits go through doc.editObject, so they can be undone. Needs the doc permission (high risk: it can modify the document).
